label: D1 early in the episode (trials < ~30), after an a1 choice or a reward
explanation: Fires almost only at D1 (93% of activation mass; never at GO, rarely at D2), and only early in the episode: rate 15% in trials 0-9, 11% in 10-19, 6% in 20-29, 2% in 30-39, zero from trial 50 on. Inside that window it is biased toward D1 steps where the previous trial was rewarded (in_rew=1, 76% of mass) or the previous choice was a1 / previous state S1 (71% of mass for prev_action=1), and toward episodes where S1 starts good. The strongest activations are D1 steps following an a1 / S1 trial, often after a run of rewarded a1 choices, and the unit is active when the model value is in a narrow middle band (7.54-7.73). Simple (phase==D1)&(ep_trial<30) gets mass recall 0.89 but precision 0.27; the recorded predicate adds the a1-or-rewarded condition (dev F1 0.47, mass recall 0.77). Adding conditions on a1 AND reward raises precision to 0.50 but drops recall. Only observed variables are used. Precision stays low: many early D1 steps after reward on a2 do not fire, so the unit is only partly described, probably an early-episode transient that depends on choice history.
